youtube.title: Paani mein ungliyan kyun sikud jaati hain? 🛁 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Paani mein der tak haath rakhne par ungliyan sikud jaati hain. Zyaadatar log sochte hain ki skin paani soakh kar phool jaati hai. Lekin 1930 ke dashak mein doctors ne ek ajeeb cheez dekhi: jin patients ki ungli ki nerve damage thi, unki ungliyan bilkul nahi sikudti thi.

Yaani ye sirf paani ka kaam nahi hai. Aapka nervous system skin ke neeche ki blood vessels ko sikodta hai. Shayad iska fayda grip hai. Ek experiment mein sikudi ungliyon wale log geele marbles tezi se utha paaye, jaise tyre ke tread paani ko hata dete hain.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
